final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT b.link_to_event, e.type, AVG(b.spent / b.amount) as avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.type), step2 AS (SELECT type, AVG(avg_ratio) as type_avg FROM step1 GROUP BY type), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) as overall_avg FROM step2) SELECT step2.type, step2.type_avg, step2.type_avg / step3.overall_avg as ratio FROM step2, step3 WHERE step3.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
